rules: 1. In S1 (lines 135-168), return `backendStore.get("share-multi-page-id") ?? new ArrayBuffer(0)` on any non-`POST` `fetch` call regardless of the URL's form.

tests.name: renders the page tab bar by default in ExcalidrawApp
tests.expect: data-testid="page-bar" is present in the rendered app

tests.name: round-trips all pages, elements, viewports, and activePageId through share links (exportToBackend and importFromBackend)
tests.given: a multi-page scene with two pages, elements on both pages, custom per-page viewports, and activePageId set to page-2 exported via exportToBackend and imported via importFromBackend
tests.expect: the imported and restored scene preserves all pages in order, their names, per-page scrollX/scrollY/zoom, all elements with their pageId, and activePageId === 'page-2'

tests.name: round-trips all pages, elements, viewports, and activePageId through local autosave (LocalData and importFromLocalStorage)
tests.given: a multi-page scene with two pages, elements on both pages, custom per-page viewports, and activePageId set to page-2 saved via LocalData.save + LocalData.flushSave and loaded via importFromLocalStorage
tests.expect: the restored localStorage state preserves all pages, their elements, per-page viewports, and activePageId === 'page-2'

tests.name: saves and loads room pages in Firebase as a backward-compatible JSON array so a room loaded with no peers online keeps every element on its own page
tests.given: a collaboration room with pages page-1 and page-2 and elements on each page saved via saveToFirebase and loaded via loadFromFirebase with no peers online
tests.expect: the encrypted ciphertext decodes to a JSON array accepted by restoreElements, loadFromFirebase returns both pages and elements, and after applying the loaded room state to the scene, page-1 shows only page-1 elements and switching to page-2 shows page-2 elements
